name: finpilot-ai
description: Run from the project root: `npm run dev` starts the backend (port 8000) and frontend (port 5173) together.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.share: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host"
scripts.seed: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'backend'); from app.db.seed import seed; seed()"
scripts.ingest: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'backend'); from app.rag.ingest import ingest; ingest()"
